regions.merged_text: It is nearly time for office - Matins - Lauds - I want to answer the above Tonight if I can I perhaps should have told the secret before - of having prayers heard in "hopeless cases." Any how I think a few little notes near by will be interestingly Encouring - over. I had to cross proposed P.S. off. - can only hope to do something better than just a P.S. Another letter from same niece Clement informs of the operation - Let us continue praying and trusting and thanking - God first of course and then all else Since the novices are gone I've been having - so far - the privilege of serving Fr. Rudolph's Mass every morning. . I really enjoy it but - but - One hardly knows how to get around . ·
